title: Countach in the Night Studio Above the City
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: One focused hour beats a perfect plan.
description:
Welcome to the Night Studio, where a liquid silver Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4 sits quietly beside floor-to-ceiling glass, looking out over a glittering city and the low glow of distant screens. All you hear across these two hours of music is calm ambient electronic sound, layered with warm synth pads, a soft deep bass, and a gentle beat. It is a peaceful place to settle in, perfect whether you are working, studying, or just taking time to relax.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
